  out=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password,keyboard-interactive "opsbot@$target" true 2>&1) && rc=0 || rc=$?
  printf 'nonkey_auth target=%s rc=%s %s\n' "$target" "$rc" "$out"
  test "$rc" -ne 0
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'Permission denied (publickey)'
done
printf 'final_auth_audit=pass\n'

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'password_field_state=[REDACTED]{print substr($2,1,1)=="!" ? "locked" : "unexpected"}'
target2=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2" {print $1; exit}')
for target in "$NODE_IP" "$target2"; do
  runuser -u opsbot -- ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519 "opsbot@$target" 'printf "key_auth_ok user=%s host=%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$(hostname)"'
  out=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password,keyboard-interactive "opsbot@$target" true 2>&1) && rc=0 || rc=$?
  printf 'nonkey_auth target=%s rc=%s %s\n' "$target" "$rc" "$out"
  test "$rc" -ne 0
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'Permission denied (publickey)'
done
printf 'final_auth_audit=pass\n'
stdout:
boot_id=8ecec894-11b0-4ae4-a19d-fd2928dc3713
password_field_state=[REDACTED]]
key_auth_ok user=opsbot host=node1
nonkey_auth target=10.100.251.10 rc=255 opsbot@10.100.251.10: Permission denied (publickey).
key_auth_ok user=opsbot host=node2
nonkey_auth target=10.100.251.11 rc=255 opsbot@10.100.251.11: Permission denied (publickey).
final_auth_audit=pass
